note: Optional checks. Add them from the Checklist tab; they are not part of the core because they are general PC hygiene rather than AI-agent risks.

title.en: Agent allow-list contains wildcards for shell or network
title.ko: 에이전트 허용 목록에 셸·네트워크 와일드카드가 있음

items.check: Permission allow rules such as Bash(*), Bash(curl:*), WebFetch(*) or equivalent in Codex/Gemini settings. Only report when approvals are also off entirely; allow rules the user wrote are a deliberate choice. Vendor-reviewed modes are the user's choice and not a finding: Claude Code auto mode (a classifier reviews each action), Codex approvals with the sandbox on.

fix.en: Replace wildcards with exact commands you actually need.
fix.ko: 와일드카드 대신 실제로 쓰는 명령만 적으세요.

title.ko: 운영체제 기본 보호 기능이 꺼져 있음

items.check: Windows Defender real-time protection or a firewall profile off; macOS firewall off (off by default on macOS, so reported as medium); Linux with no firewall service running (ufw, firewalld, nftables). Disk encryption is checked by disk-encryption-off.

fix.en: Turn them back on. Shieldbug complements them, it does not replace them.
fix.ko: 다시 켜세요. Shieldbug는 이걸 대신하지 않고 보완합니다.

items.check: Last installed security update older than 45 days.
Windows BitLocker or Device encryption off on the system drive, macOS FileVault off, Linux with no dm-crypt (LUKS) device. Skipped inside WSL.

fix.en: Turn on BitLocker / Device encryption, FileVault, or LUKS. A lost laptop then does not hand over every key on it.
fix.ko: BitLocker·장치 암호화, FileVault, LUKS를 켜세요. 노트북을 잃어버려도 안의 키가 통째로 새지 않아요.

title.en: SSH private key without a passphrase

items.check: Private keys under ~/.ssh that are not encrypted.

fix.en: ssh-keygen -p -f <key> to add a passphrase, or keep the key in an agent or hardware key.
fix.ko: ssh-keygen -p -f <키>로 비밀번호를 걸거나, ssh-agent·하드웨어 키에 보관하세요.
